[
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-5.5-1",
    "section": "5.5",
    "section_title": "Software Back-ups and Redundancy",
    "text": "Post back-up everyday the back-up shall be restored on a dummy production system to ensure completeness and correctness of back-up.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-5.5-2",
    "section": "5.5",
    "section_title": "Software Back-ups and Redundancy",
    "text": "Post that the dummy production database shall be purged.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-5.5-3",
    "section": "5.5",
    "section_title": "Software Back-ups and Redundancy",
    "text": "Since the data is confidential, it will be maintained in Mangalore HQ in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-1",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "System shall be available only on Specified PinCodes (Zones). These will be set-up in the Parameter Control File",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-2",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "All Users shall access the system using a login/user-id and password. The login-id/password will be managed in a secured manner",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-3",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Speciality ‘has’ one or more Doctors linked to it.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-4",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Doctor shall be mapped to ONE and ONLY ONE Speciality.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-5",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Doctor shall provide Consultation to ONE or More Patient",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-6",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Patient has to register himself/ herself by filling Patient profile - a unique id will be generated for the Patient.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-7",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Patient can request for one or more consultation Requests (linked back to Speciality).",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-8",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Patient Consultation Request ‘Generates’ ONE prescription. Each Prescription shall be mapped to ONE AND ONLY ONE Patient Consultation Request.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-9",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Chemist “receives” one or more prescriptions (only required fields). Each prescription is mapped to (vide workflow using Pincode) ONE and ONLY ONE Chemist",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "BR-10",
    "section": "5.6",
    "section_title": "Business Rules",
    "text": "Each Lab “receives” one or more prescriptions (only required fields). Each prescription is mapped to (vide workflow using Pincode) ONE and ONLY ONE Labs",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  }
]
